articles.summary: Mach9 announces native LGSx integration with Leica Geosystems, enabling field-to-finish mapping workflows from Leica Pegasus TRK, RTC360, BLK360, and BLK2GO into Digital Surveyor 2 for automated feature extraction.
articles.title: Mach9 Digital Surveyor Customers Unlock New Productivity Gains with Seamless Leica LGSx Integration
